senses.gloss: (cmp. חָכַךְ) to contract, farm, esp. to give or to take in rent on a fixed annual rental payable in kind, contrad. to אָרַס, שָׂכַר or קִבֵּל q. v.—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:2">B. Mets. IX, 2</cite> <he>חֲכוֹר לי וכ׳</he> give me in rent &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:2">Tosef. Dem. VI, 2</cite> <he>החוֹכֵר שדה</he> if one takes in rent a field.
Ib. מה בין שוכר לחוכר what is the difference between the sokher and the ḥokher?; a. fr.—V. חָכִיר.
B. Mets. 104ᵃ; a. e.—Part. pass. מוּחְכָּר, f. מוּחְכֶּרֶת.
B. Bath. 123ᵇ, sq. פרה מ׳ a cow rented out for half-profit (Rashi).
